feature.label: DBeaver 3D Schema Graph
feature.description: Visualizes a database schema as an interactive 3D graph inside DBeaver: tables as nodes, foreign keys as edges, with zoom/rotate/drag/select, object details, and navigate-to-object. Reuses the MIT-licensed "Advanced Graph View" Pixi.js renderer inside an SWT Browser.
